newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA trade was at a near standstill in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers with bids remaining mostly at 66.00. Last established market was a light test Friday at 68.00 and feedlots continue to ask 68.00 or more. Sales reported on 200 slaughter heifers; 22,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 21,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Heifers - pen select and choice 2-3 1100 lbs north plains 68.00.
Wk to date: 22,000 Week ago: 25,700 Year ago: 32,300
